description: This file defines the implementation of the GenericPlayerTaskFactory class, which creates various task objects related to media playback control in a GStreamer-based media player. It includes methods for creating tasks such as attach source, handle bus messages, set volume, and more, which are used to manage media playback operations.

classes.name: firebolt::rialto::server::GenericPlayerTaskFactory
classes.description: Implementation of a factory class that creates various media playback tasks for a GStreamer-based media player.

methods.name: createAttachSamples
methods.description: Creates a task to attach media samples to the pipeline.

methods.name: createAttachSource
methods.description: Creates a task to attach a media source to the pipeline.

methods.name: createDeepElementAdded
methods.description: Creates a task for handling deep element added event in the pipeline.

methods.name: createEnoughData
methods.description: Creates a task indicating sufficient data is available.

methods.name: createEos
methods.description: Creates an End-Of-Stream (EOS) task for a specific media source type.

methods.name: createFinishSetupSource
methods.description: Creates a task to finalize source setup.

methods.name: createHandleBusMessage
methods.description: Creates a task to handle GStreamer bus messages.

methods.name: createNeedData

methods.name: createPause
methods.description: Creates a task to pause playback.

methods.name: createPlay

methods.name: createReadShmDataAndAttachSamples
methods.description: Creates a task to read shared memory data and attach samples.

methods.name: createCheckAudioUnderflow
